source.name: Alaska Department of Fish and Game, Division of Wildlife Conservation — Harvest Information: General Harvest Reports (report 330 "Hunter AK Residency and Success by Unit") and Harvest Lookup & Data Download, regulatory year 2025 (interim)

notes: ADF&G regulatory year (RY) 2025 = July 1, 2025 - June 30, 2026, pulled 2026-10-07 from ADF&G's Harvest Information tool; ADF&G labels every recent year "Interim", so late harvest reports can still change these numbers. Built from hunter harvest reports (permit reports and harvest-ticket reports). hunters = ADF&G "Total Hunters" = hunters who reported hunting (successful + unsuccessful); harvest = "Successful"; successPct = harvest / hunters x 100, rounded to 0.1. Hunters who did not hunt or did not report are not counted. Three scopes. (1) Drawing permit hunts (huntCode = ADF&G hunt number, D... and youth Y... hunts) and (2) Registration permit hunts (R...): one row per hunt, all residencies combined, taken from report 330 filtered to that hunt (its "Total" row); unit = the unit with the most hunters in that report, label lists every unit reported. ADF&G left the unit blank for 29 hunts (mostly Unit 7, 14C and 15 sheep/goat/moose hunts, plus DX001 and RX110); their unit comes from the hunt's row in the 2026-2027 regulations. Hunts the report tool does not list (e.g., Unit 7/15 goat registration hunts RG334-RG374, DM819, RM849) had no hunters in ADF&G's RY2025 harvest records and have no row. (3) General season (harvest ticket) hunts: huntCode "GEN-<unit>" with residency rows (resident / nonresident; hunters with no residency recorded are left out). Moose (hunt GM000) and Dall sheep (GS000) come straight from report 330 filtered to ADF&G's "General Season" hunt. ADF&G's report tool has no general-season filter for caribou, so caribou GEN rows are DERIVED: the unit's total for all caribou hunts minus every caribou permit hunt reported in that unit (the result matches ADF&G's GC000 harvest-record download for every unit, without residency). Caribou bags in Units 24-26 allow several animals; ADF&G counts reports, so a hunter may count more than once there. GEN rows are kept only for units that have a harvest-ticket season in the 2026-2027 Alaska Hunting Regulations (see lib/huntdata/draw/ak-general-research.md); a handful of general-season reports coded to units with no harvest-ticket season (e.g., moose in Units 1-5, 9, 20A-20D after those went to permits) and reports with an unknown subunit were left out, as were nonresident reports in resident-only units. Not included: Sitka black-tailed deer (ADF&G publishes deer hunters and deer per hunter by unit, not the share of hunters who took a deer, so no successPct; see the research notes), bears, Tier I/II (T...), community (C...), targeted (A...) and S-prefixed subsistence hunts, and hunts with no hunters reported. Hunt numbers are reused across years, so rows describe the RY2025 version of each hunt.
